resources.string: Running as root, so full app data can be archived and restored, not just the APK.

A data restore cannot bring back hardware-backed key material: it stays with the old install. Apps that tie secrets to the device keystore, such as banking apps and messengers, may still refuse to start after a restore. Restoring data from a newer app version into an older one can also break the app.
The app is force-stopped before and after, so its databases are not caught mid-write.
